entry_state: Award amendment and participation methods retain valuation dates, service clocks and earnings rights. The dependent-EPS examples compute consequential worlds while leaving their general selection unresolved; contingent admission has a separate similar-option prerequisite before group accounting begins.
findings: 229–230: The participating-tax derivation separates actual benefit H from the hypothetical residual adjustment. Signed R=P−D explains the negative year3 adjustment without a negative cash dividend. N_O=(b+ta)P reproduces120/200/40; this is basic EPS with supplied rights, not general diluted selection.

Retained control transfers equity without profit; loss of control removes goodwill/NCI and admits independently measured retained interests. Inventory elimination preserves external cost60 and the independently supported purchaser tax basis.

233–234: Functional-currency remeasurement and group translation use different populations. The joined foreign acquisition explains goodwill19.2→20.8, parent-only goodwill OCI1.6, NCI31.2 and cash exchange7 versus translation OCI12.6. Event-rate inventory translation avoids an artificial negative stock.
